Gist: I've written down your condition. The two held items come back only after a demo in which every P-number works from your side as a user; a green suite or a scripted check doesn't count. So those items wait on the demo, not on P12 alone.

It's in two places in the mission file (692f8648):
- the deferral note (item 17.4) now points to the amendment;
- the P21 record quotes your words, and they replace my proposal of "the first unscripted blocker escalation".

The attestation still isn't in futon1b's index; the background check is still waiting on the catch-up.

Next is the DOCUMENT account. It could double as the script for that demo, taking each P-number in the order you'd meet it as a user.
